metaDescription: A 3-minute daily round that trains your team to spot scams.

start.title: Can you spot the scam?
start.intro: 10 real-looking messages: emails, texts, voicemails and payment requests. Mark each one Legit or Scam, then see exactly what gave it away.
steps: Read the message like you would at work.
Swipe right or tap Legit if it's safe. Swipe left or tap Scam if it isn't.
Learn the red flags and earn points. Get 3 in a row for a streak bonus.
start.keyboardHint: Keyboard: ← Scam · → Legit · Enter for the next card
start.demoNote: Demo round. No sign-in, and nothing is saved.
start.practiceNote: You've done today's round. Extra rounds are practice and don't change your record.

links.linkLabel: Link: {text}. Shows where it really goes.
links.habit: Before you tap a link at work, press and hold it on your phone (or hover over it on a computer) to see where it really goes.

errors.not_signed_in: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.no_membership: You're not part of a company yet.
errors.no_scenarios: There are no cards available yet. Please try again later.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find that round. Please start again.
errors.out_of_order: Please answer the cards in order.
errors.invalid_input: Something didn't look right. Please try again.

home.eyebrow: Daily scam training for your team
home.title: Spot the scam before it costs you
home.intro: Three minutes a day. Real-looking emails, texts, voicemails and payment requests. Your team learns the red flags, and you get a training record.
home.todayDone: Today's round is done: {score} of {total} correct, {points} pts.

progress.streakHint: Counts your company's training days. Other days are bonus rounds.
progress.streakTodayDue: Play today to keep it going
progress.streakDayOff: Not a training day: bonus round
progress.practiceNoProgress: Practice rounds don't change your level, streak or league.

league.title: Weekly league
league.intro: Record rounds from Monday to Sunday ({start} – {end}). Practice rounds don't count.
league.teamsNote: Teams rank by average points per member, so every teammate counts.
league.empty: No rounds played yet this week. Be the first!

auth.title: Sign in to Scam Shield
auth.intro: Enter your work email and we'll send you a sign-in link. No password needed.
auth.sent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.
auth.failed: We couldn't send the link. Please try again.
auth.cooldown: We just sent a link to this address. Please wait {seconds} seconds before asking for another one.
auth.cooldownShort: Too many requests just now. Please wait a minute, then try again.
auth.hourlyLimit: Too many sign-in emails were sent recently. Use the most recent link in your inbox, or try again in about an hour.
auth.linkFailed: That sign-in link didn't work or has expired. Please request a new one.

onboarding.title: Set up your company
onboarding.intro: You'll be the owner. You can invite your team on the next screen.
onboarding.alreadyMember: You already belong to a company.
onboarding.failed: We couldn't create your company. Please try again.

team.title: Team & invites
team.inviteIntro: Share this link with your staff. Anyone who opens it signs in with their email and joins {company} as a player. Links expire after 14 days.
team.ownersOnly: Only owners and admins can manage invites.
team.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
team.playDaysIntro: Pick the days your team is expected to play. Missing one of these breaks a player's streak; rounds on other days are bonus.
team.playDaysReadOnly: Your company's training days. Only the owner can change them.
team.notOwner: Only the owner can change training days.

join.title: Join {company}
join.intro: {company} uses Scam Shield for a quick daily scam-spotting round.
join.invalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask your manager for a new one.
join.alreadyMember: You already belong to another company, so you can't join this one.
join.failed: We couldn't add you. Please try again.

play.swipeHint: Swipe left for Scam, right for Legit

end.title: Round complete
end.missedNone: Nothing got past you. Every scam was caught.
end.falseAlarmsNote: Being careful is good, but false alarms slow real work. Look for the absence of red flags too.
end.savedPractice: Practice round saved. Today's record is unchanged.

verdicts.great: Sharp eyes. You'd be hard to fool.
verdicts.good: Solid. A few tricks still slipped through.
verdicts.learning: Good practice. These scams fool smart people every day.
